annotation.interpretation_a: The Push ID must be unique across all push stream headers sent by the same endpoint.
annotation.interpretation_b: The Push ID must be unique within a single push stream header, but can be reused in subsequent headers.
annotation.justification: The clause states a Push ID "MUST only be used once", but does not specify the scope of this uniqueness. It could mean unique across all push stream headers, or only unique within a single header. This leads to two reasonable interpretations with different implementation consequences.
annotation.missing_information: The scope of 'once' is not defined. Does it apply to all headers, or only within a single header?
